what: A lit Section with the same content is laid over a dark Section and hidden by an SVG mask, lighting only the spot of a blurred circle 550px in diameter with 50px feather — the circle sticks to the cursor with no lag (if scrolling with the hand off, it snaps up to 30px from the top of the screen) and over the scroll range 100→400px it retracts in a straight line. Pressing the lamp button fully lights the background rect in .8s (brightness .006 → 1), revealing the whole lit Section, and pressing again turns it off. It starts left on, then is turned off with fx:light after the loader lifts

options.blur: Circle blur (px, Gaussian standard deviation), default 50
options.base: Brightness at which the background shows through when off (0~1), default .006 — original #101010
options.lit: If on, starts switched on, default off
options.switch: Lamp button css — press to turn on and off. is-on · aria-pressed on the button
options.x · y: Initial circle position (% of panel width · screen height), default 4 · 12
options.scroll-top: On scroll, moves the circle down this many px from the top of the screen — original 30. Without it the circle sticks to the panel and rises with it
options.fade: Scroll range over which the circle clears (two px values, space-separated) — original 100 400
options.fx:light: On the element, CustomEvent("fx:light", { detail: true|false }) sends it to toggle on and off (flips if no detail). When on, the element gets is-lit

use:
…Dark panel…
…same content, light version…
note: On devices without a pointer, the circle stays at its starting position (it doesn’t follow). With reduced motion, leave it on. Mask coordinates have 0 at the top left of the panel, so the panel starts at the very top of the document (position absolute; Place it at top 0)

from.where: index.html .sh-lit + #sh-mask — original .wrapper1 mask-image url(#mask): #mask-rect fill #101010 (#fff if .is_rect, transition .8s) + #mask-circle 550×550 rx 1000 blur(50px), pageX/Y − 275 on mousemove, y on scroll = scrollY + 30, ScrollTrigger #top top+=100 → top+=400 scrub autoAlpha 0, .light_switch click toggles is_rect
